objective: Review the completed pulp_ita_mha shape expansion and decide whether to move to another workload, resident runtime optimization, or result packaging refresh.

reviewed_result.trend: 32x1 state-parallel timing is much more favorable than 1x32 single-state repeated-step timing in the scoped full ITA/MHA run.
reviewed_result.weakness: The fresh MHA chain is useful evidence, but it is still scoped to coverage-output equivalence and single-run timing. It does not by itself add production LLM-serving throughput, model-level Transformer inference, or a new KV-cache memory hierarchy claim.

options_reviewed.reason: Paged-attention and KV-cache scale-up remain relevant, but this repository already has historical paged-attention/KV evidence. Starting another workload now would broaden the active surface before the fresh MHA generic-host-probe chain is reflected in the public source-of-truth path.
options_reviewed.weakness: Would add or revive workload-specific templates and overlays while the current review boundary is only the completed MHA shape expansion.

options_reviewed.reason: Resident and persistent resident optimization already have separate gate evidence. Mixing runtime/ABI work into this MHA shape review would blur the boundary between workload evidence and runtime optimization.
options_reviewed.weakness: Would shift from RTL workload characterization to runtime/pass behavior and require a separate ABI gate before implementation.

options_reviewed.reason: The fresh full ITA/MHA 1x1 plus 32x1/1x32 generic-host-probe chain should be reflected in the public/result packaging path before adding another workload or runtime gate.
options_reviewed.weakness: This does not create new measurement evidence; it only updates source-of-truth packaging around completed evidence.

selected_next_workstream.name: result_packaging_refresh
scope: refresh docs/results.md and public-pack references to include the fresh pulp_ita_mha first and shape-expansion gate chain
keep reports and artifacts as generated evidence, not source of truth
preserve coverage_output_equivalence as the correctness policy
avoid new workload, runtime, or MobileViT implementation changes in the packaging refresh

non_claims: not a runtime or ABI change
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
